metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2023 · Castlevania: Nocturne
metas.description: During the French Revolution, vampire hunter prodigy Richter Belmont fights to uphold his family's legacy and prevent the rise of a ruthless, power-hungry vampire.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2022 · Pantheon
metas.description: A young woman starts to get messages from an unknown number that claims to be her deceased father. Trying to uncover the truth, she stumbles upon a larger conspiracy involving the singularity.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2024 · Dead Boy Detectives
metas.description: Charles Rowland and Edwin Payne choose not to enter the afterlife, instead staying on Earth to investigate crimes that involve the supernatural, with help from their living psychic medium friend.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2021 · Dota: Dragon's Blood
metas.description: After encounters with a dragon and a princess on her own mission, a Dragon Knight becomes embroiled in events larger than he could have ever imagined.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2023 · Scott Pilgrim Takes Off
metas.description: Scott Pilgrim meets the girl of his dreams, Ramona Flowers, only to find out her seven evil exes stand in the way of their love.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2025 · Legend of Zang Hai
metas.description: Set in a legendary ancient time China, a man works in ruling government dedicates to civilian lives

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2023 · The Amazing Digital Circus
metas.description: A woman finds herself trapped in a virtual circus where she and five other humans are subject to the whims of wacky AI. In this digital purgatory they must face frightening NPCs and cope with their own personal traumas.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2025 · Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
metas.description: Peter Parker is on his way to becoming a hero, but his path to get there is anything but ordinary.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2024 · Dragon Ball Daima
metas.description: Due to a conspiracy, Goku and friends are transformed into children. They intend to travel to a mysterious new world to undo this change.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2021 · The North Water
metas.description: A disgraced former military doctor embarks as a surgeon aboard a whaler bound for the Arctic, where his quest for redemption becomes a fight for survival.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2020 · Alex Rider
metas.description: Alex Rider is an ordinary teenager enlisted to work on behalf of MI6, where he uses skills he didn't know he had to become an extraordinary spy.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2023 · The Artful Dodger
metas.description: In 1850s Australia, the past of Jack Dawkins, a former pickpocket who has become a surgeon, resurfaces when an old acquaintance, Fagin, arrives and lures him back into a life of crime.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2025 · Sakamoto Days
metas.description: Taro Sakamoto was once the greatest hitman of all time, but he gave it all up for love. Now, with his past lurking, he'll have to fight like never before.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2023 · Mashle: Magic and Muscles
metas.description: Into a world of magicians is born Mash, a young boy who lacks magic but is the strongest person around. His existence and destiny will change his world.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2026 · Ride or Die
metas.description: Two best friends, Judith and Debbie, discover Judith is secretly an assassin. After a hit goes wrong, they go on the run while being targeted by a mysterious enemy, forcing them to confront the secrets between them.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2023 · Moving
metas.description: The quiet lives of three high school students with genetic superhuman abilities turn upside down when a mysterious organization starts to hunt them down one by one.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2025 · Lord of Mysteries
metas.description: Zhou Mingrui awakens in the body of Klein Moretti in a Victorian world of steam and hidden magic. As a new Beyonder, he confronts secret societies and dark rituals while seeking the truth behind his mysterious transmigration.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2025 · Gachiakuta
metas.description: In a floating city, a young boy is framed for the death of his father and exiled. He ends up in a junkyard zone, and swears to return for revenge.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2022 · The Eminence in Shadow
metas.description: When Cid is isekai'd to another world, he creates an underground organization to live out a fight against a made-up cult. Little does he know the cult is real, and they're not happy his power fantasy just impeded their plans.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2022 · The Bastard Son & The Devil Himself
metas.description: Caught between two warring clans, the son of a notorious witch responsible for a deadly massacre tries to find his place in the world — and his powers.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2021 · Ranking of Kings
metas.description: The people of the kingdom look down on the young Prince Bojji, who can neither hear nor speak. They call him "The Useless Prince" while jeering at his supposed foolishness.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2024 · Delicious in Dungeon
metas.description: Can sisters be reincarnated from dragon meat? Laios and his friends Marcille and Chilchuck delve into an endless dungeon in search of his fallen sister, fighting monsters, starvation, and corruption.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2025 · The Mighty Nein
metas.description: Follows a group of criminals and misfits who are the only ones that can prevent the kingdom from plunging into chaos when an arcane artifact capable of reshaping reality falls into the wrong hands.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2020 · Close Enough
metas.description: A comedic look at a couple facing various challenges in their daily lives while trying to cope with their changes from twenties to thirties.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2020 · Julie and the Phantoms
metas.description: Julie is a teenage girl who finds her passion for music and life with the help of a high-concept band of teen boys "The Phantoms" who have been dead for 25 years. Julie, in turn, helps them become the band they were never able to be.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2020 · Jurassic World: Camp Cretaceous
metas.description: Six teens attending an adventure camp on the opposite side of Isla Nublar must band together to survive when dinosaurs wreak havoc on the island.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2024 · The Count of Monte Cristo
metas.description: Edmond Dantes, a sailor falsely accused of treason, is imprisoned in the Château d'If off Marseille. After escaping, and adopting the identity of the Count of Monte Cristo, he plans revenge against those who wrongly accused him.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2021 · To Your Eternity
metas.description: A lonely boy wandering the Arctic regions of North America meets a wolf, and the two become fast friends, depending on each other to survive the harsh environment. But the boy has a history, and the wolf is more than meets the eye...

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2021 · Law & Order: Organized Crime
metas.description: Former SVU Detective Elliot Stabler returns to the NYPD to join a new Taskforce that works to dismantle illegal criminal enterprises.

metas.name: ★ 8.6 · 2023 · Adventure Time: Fionna & Cake
metas.description: Fionna, her best friend Cake and the former Ice King, Simon Petrikov, embark on an adventure through the multiverse, dodging new threats and making self-discoveries along the way.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2023 · Heavenly Delusion
metas.description: A boy grows up behind the safe walls of an apocalyptic Japan full of monsters. Tokyo flourishes as a paradise, while outside the walls of hell dangers lurk. However, a small group searches for heaven.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2021 · Hit-Monkey
metas.description: It tells the tale of a wronged Japanese snow monkey, mentored by the ghost of an American assassin, as he cuts a wide swath through the Tokyo underworld.

metas.name: ★ 8.6 · 2020 · Adventure Time: Distant Lands
metas.description: Four hour-long specials that explore the unseen corners of the world of Adventure Time with both familiar and exciting brand-new characters.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2023 · My Adventures with Superman
metas.description: Clark Kent builds his secret Superman identity and embraces his role as the hero of Metropolis, while sharing adventures and falling in love with Lois Lane, a star investigative journalist, who also takes Jimmy Olsen under her wing.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2020 · AJ and the Queen
metas.description: Ruby Red, a down-on-her-luck drag queen traveling across America, develops an unlikely sidekick named AJ.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2020 · James May: Our Man in...
metas.description: James May embarks on a remarkable journey across Japan, from its icy north to its balmy south. He'll see the sights, meet the locals, and eat the noodles in a bid to truly understand the Land of the Rising Sun.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2026 · The Wonderfools
metas.description: A group of awkward townies who unexpectedly gain superpowers and fight villains threatening the peace of Haeseong city.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2025 · Witch Hat Atelier
metas.description: The series follows a girl named Coco, who dreams of being a witch, but in her world only those born with magical abilities are able to become witches. However, after meeting a witch named Qifrey, Coco's dream begins to come true.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2020 · Kipo and the Age of Wonderbeasts
metas.description: A girl explores the possibilities in a post-apocalyptic world.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2020 · Great Pretender
metas.description: A Japanese conman crosses paths with a French rival, and gets entangled in conspiracies and scams beyond his wildest dreams.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2021 · Star Trek: Prodigy
metas.description: A group of enslaved teenagers steal a derelict Starfleet vessel to escape and explore the galaxy.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2023 · Shangri-La Frontier
metas.description: High schooler Rakuro loves beating bad games. But can he discover all the secrets hidden in a best-selling VR game?
